name: trakka-notifications
description: Server-side piece of Trakka's push notifications — see scripts/send-notifications.mjs and .github/workflows/notify.yml. Lives in its own notifications/ folder, separate from the repo root, specifically so Cloudflare Pages (which auto-installs any package.json it finds in the build root, even with an empty build command) never sees this one and tries to npm-install firebase-admin for what is otherwise a plain static site with no build step of its own.
